item.title: 库克谈 Apple Watch 未来：帮助用户掌握健康信息
item.guid: 库克谈-Apple-Watch-未来：帮助用户掌握健康信息
item.description:
On October 12, during an interview with iFanr in Beijing, Cook was asked about the future development of Apple Watch in the next decade. Cook stated that Apple Watch aims to be everyone's "personal guardian" for health, helping users live a healthier day. 10 月 12 日，在北京接受爱范儿采访时，库克被问及 Apple Watch 在未来十年会如何发展。库克表示，Apple Watch 要成为每个人健康的「个人守护者」，帮助用户过上更健康的一天。

Cook cited sleep apnea as an example: many patients are unaware they have this problem, and Apple hopes to alert them so they can seek the help they need. 库克以睡眠呼吸暂停为例：许多患者并不知道自己存在这一问题，苹果希望提醒他们，让他们能够寻求所需的帮助。

Cook stated that Apple hopes to put information that users previously couldn't access into their hands, helping them sleep better, exercise more, stand more, burn more calories; and when needed, go to the hospital or seek a doctor's help. 库克表示，苹果希望把用户原本无法获得的信息交到他们手中，帮助他们睡得更好、多运动、多站立、消耗更多热量；在需要时，去医院或寻求医生帮助。

item.title: 马斯克回应「中国版马斯克」：想邀请他同台跳舞
item.guid: 马斯克回应「中国版马斯克」：想邀请他同台跳舞
item.description:
According to a report by The Beijing News, Elon Musk responded to the viral "Chinese Elon Musk" video during the X Takeover event held on October 10, stating that he would like to find an opportunity to invite the person to dance on stage with him, saying it "would be very interesting." 据新京报报道，马斯克在 10 月 10 日举行的 X Takeover 活动中，回应了网络上走红的「中国版马斯克」视频，表示想找机会邀请对方一起上台跳舞，「会很有意思」。

Musk participated in the event held at the Tesla Gigafactory in Austin, Texas, via video link that day. He said he looks a bit Asian, and with 1.4 billion people in China, there must be someone who looks like him; he still had doubts about whether the person in the video was real. 马斯克当日通过视频连线参加在得克萨斯州奥斯汀特斯拉超级工厂举行的活动。他说，自己看起来有点像亚洲人，中国有 14 亿人口，肯定有人长得像自己；对于视频中的人物是否真实，他仍带着疑问。

The host mentioned the internet personality known as "Ma Yilong." In 2021, he gained popularity on TikTok due to his resemblance to Elon Musk, and Musk had previously expressed a desire to meet him. This latest public statement of willingness to share the stage was still an expression of desire during a live interaction, with no confirmed meeting or performance arrangements. 主持人提到的是被称为「马一龙」的网络人物。2021 年，他因外形与马斯克相似在 TikTok 走红，马斯克此前也曾表示想见见他。此次同台表态仍是现场交流中的意愿，没有确定会面或演出的安排。

item.title: 博通 CEO：晶圆与内存短缺正在缓解，AI 扩张更受资金约束
item.guid: 博通-CEO：晶圆与内存短缺正在缓解，AI-扩张更受资金约束
item.description:
According to Reuters, Broadcom CEO Hock Tan stated at a discussion in Singapore on October 12 that as AI continues to develop, capital will become the biggest constraint companies face. 据路透社报道，博通 CEO 谭浩克 10 月 12 日在新加坡一场讨论会上表示，随着 AI 继续发展，资金将成为公司面对的最大约束。

He stated that Broadcom is overcoming issues of insufficient wafer and memory supply, and the next major bottleneck will shift to capital. Regarding the commercialization of AI, he believes that Anthropic and OpenAI have demonstrated that deploying the latest models as AI personal assistants can generate significant revenue. 他表示，博通正在克服晶圆和内存供应不足的问题，接下来的主要瓶颈会转向资本。谈到 AI 的商业化，他认为 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 已经证明，部署为 AI 个人助理的最新模型能够带来可观收入。

item.title: 三季度全球手机出货下降 20%，苹果份额升至 22%
item.guid: 三季度全球手机出货下降-20%，苹果份额升至-22%
item.description:
Counterpoint Research released preliminary statistics showing that global smartphone shipments in Q3 2026 decreased by 20% year-on-year, falling to their lowest third-quarter level since 2012. Persistent memory shortages, along with rising DRAM and NAND costs, have constrained manufacturers' production and supply capabilities. Counterpoint Research 公布初步统计，2026 年第三季度全球智能手机出货量同比下降 20%，降至 2012 年以来最低的第三季度水平。内存持续短缺，以及 DRAM、NAND 成本上涨，压缩了厂商的生产与供货能力。

Samsung's shipments decreased by 3% year-on-year, but its market share rose to 23%, maintaining its number one position; Apple's share reached 22%, exceeding 20% for the first time in a third quarter, though its shipments still declined year-on-year. Counterpoint attributed part of Apple's decline to the absence of the base model iPhone 18 in the quarter, with channel distribution scale being smaller than the previous year's complete iPhone 17 series. 三星出货量同比下降 3%，但市场份额升至 23%，继续排名第一；苹果份额达到 22%，首次在第三季度超过 20%，其出货量仍同比下滑。Counterpoint 将苹果的下滑部分归因于当季缺少基础款 iPhone 18，渠道铺货规模小于前一年完整的 iPhone 17 系列。

Xiaomi's shipments decreased by over 30%, with its share falling back to 10%; OPPO and vivo both saw shipments decline by over 20%, with shares of 9% and 8% respectively. The statistics use a sell-in methodology (shipments from manufacturers to channels), where OPPO includes OnePlus and realme. 小米出货量降幅超过 30%，份额回落至 10%；OPPO、vivo 出货量均下降超过 20%，份额分别为 9% 和 8%。统计采用厂商向渠道出货的 sell-in 口径，其中 OPPO 包含一加和 realme。

The agency pointed out that under memory cost pressure, manufacturers are raising prices and reducing low-profit models and markets, while consumers are extending their phone replacement cycles and increasingly considering refurbished devices. High-end demand remains relatively strong, while price-sensitive markets face greater pressure. 机构指出，厂商在内存成本压力下提高价格、收缩低利润机型与市场，消费者则延长换机周期、更多考虑翻新设备。高端需求相对坚挺，价格敏感市场承受更大压力。

item.title: 人脸也能「明码标价」：授权平台报价 500 至 10000 元，不少人上传后一单未接
item.guid: 人脸也能「明码标价」：授权平台报价-500-至-10000-元，不少人上传后一单未接
item.description:
Nandu N Video released an investigation on October 12. Reporters tested face authorization platforms such as Xinzhao AIGC, Mirafans Jingjie, and Yuanxiang Xinsheng, finding that authorization quotes vary by use, ranging from 500 yuan to 10,000 yuan. 南都 N 视频 10 月 12 日发布调查，记者实测新爪 AIGC、Mirafans 镜界、元相新生等人脸授权平台发现，授权报价按用途划分，从 500 元至 10000 元不等。

Buyers can use authorized images for advertisements, film and television dramas, games, and other scenarios. Some platforms allow uploaders to individually select whether to accept themes such as "death scenes," "intimate emotional scenes," and "passionate scenes." 买家可将获授权形象用于广告、影视剧、游戏等场景，部分平台允许上传者逐项选择是否接受「死亡戏」「情感亲密戏」「激情戏」等题材。

Xinzhao AIGC requires buyers to pay and submit authorization information, which is then confirmed by the authorizing party within 24 hours. Only after approval are authorization documents generated and materials made available. The platform responded on October 8 that authorization is only for a single project and does not automatically extend to sequels, spin-offs, or derivative works, nor does existing authorization include model training. 新爪 AIGC 要求买家付款并提交授权信息后，由授权方在 24 小时内确认，通过后才生成授权文件、开放素材。平台 10 月 8 日回应称，授权仅针对单个项目，不会自动延伸到续作、番外或衍生作品，现有授权也不包含模型训练。

The platform promotes continuous income generation, but Nandu observed in user groups that many people reported not receiving orders after uploading their faces. Liu Xiao, founder of Yuanxiang Xinsheng, stated that the demand from production companies is currently not high, and the platform cannot guarantee every user will get an order; their process requires the production company to purchase specific project authorization, and then the individual confirms acceptance. A certificate of entry into the database does not equate to the production company having obtained usage permission. 平台宣传持续创收，但南都在用户群中看到，不少人反映上传人脸后一直未接到订单。元相新生创始人刘啸表示，制片方需求量目前不多，平台无法保证每个用户都有单；其流程要求制作方购买具体项目授权，再由本人确认是否接受，入库证书并不等于制作方已取得使用许可。

The investigation pointed out that unauthorized use, impersonation, reuse, or out-of-scope use may still occur at various stages of material upload, content generation, production, and distribution; authorization records, material versions, and project-by-project confirmation can provide a basis for accountability, but whether the actual usage chain is complete remains a problem for the platform. 调查指出，素材上传、内容生成、制作和发行各环节仍可能发生盗用、冒用、复用或超范围使用；授权记录、素材版本和逐项目确认能留下追责依据，实际使用链路是否完整仍是平台面临的问题。

item.title: 9 月乘用车零售同比下降 28%，新能源渗透率升至 67%
item.guid: 9-月乘用车零售同比下降-28%，新能源渗透率升至-67%
item.description:
The China Passenger Car Association announced on October 12 that national passenger car retail sales in September were 1.618 million units, a year-on-year decrease of 28% and a month-on-month increase of 5%. Cumulative retail sales from January to September were 13.334 million units, a year-on-year decrease of 21.7%. 乘联分会 10 月 12 日公布，9 月全国乘用车市场零售 161.8 万辆，同比下降 28%，环比增长 5%。1 至 9 月累计零售 1333.4 万辆，同比下降 21.7%。

Domestic new energy passenger vehicle retail sales in September decreased by 16.7% year-on-year, but the retail penetration rate rose to a record high of 67%. Retail sales of conventional fuel vehicles decreased by 43% year-on-year; among them, ordinary hybrid vehicles increased by 25% year-on-year. The increase in new energy vehicle proportion occurred simultaneously with an overall sales decline, with fuel vehicles experiencing a larger contraction. 国内新能源乘用车 9 月零售同比下降 16.7%，但零售渗透率升至 67%，创历史新高。常规燃油车零售同比下降 43%；其中普通混合动力车同比增长 25%。新能源占比提升与整体销量下降同时发生，燃油车收缩幅度更大。

The brand structure continues to shift towards independent brands: in September, independent brands retailed 1.13 million vehicles, accounting for 69.8% of the domestic retail market; mainstream joint venture brands retailed 310,000 vehicles, and luxury cars retailed 170,000 vehicles. The report points out that high oil prices have a significant impact on fuel vehicles, and dealers are more cautious in purchasing goods. Most dealers believe that the peak season effect of "Golden September and Silver October" this year is weaker than in previous years. 品牌结构继续向自主品牌倾斜：9 月自主品牌零售 113 万辆，占国内零售市场的 69.8%；主流合资品牌零售 31 万辆，豪华车零售 17 万辆。报告指出，高油价对燃油车的冲击明显，经销商进货更谨慎，多数经销商认为今年「金九银十」的旺季效应弱于往年。

item.title: 大众 CEO 呼吁加强合作，应对中国车企竞争
item.guid: 大众-CEO-呼吁加强合作，应对中国车企竞争
item.description:
On the eve of the Paris Motor Show, Volkswagen Group CEO Oliver Blume called on France and Germany to strengthen cooperation to enhance the European automotive industry's ability to face Chinese competition. At the "For Europe" event on October 11, he urged companies to improve competitiveness and also called on policymakers to create suitable conditions for European industries. 在巴黎车展前夕，大众汽车集团 CEO 奥博穆呼吁法国与德国加强合作，提升欧洲汽车业面对中国竞争的能力。10 月 11 日的「For Europe」活动上，他要求企业提高竞争力，也要求政策制定者为欧洲产业创造合适的条件。

According to a live report by The Guardian, the pressures listed by Blume include high energy costs, inflation suppressing consumer demand, the need to accelerate development, and competition from Chinese car manufacturers. He supports the EU's proposed "Made in Europe" rules, advocating for companies that invest and conduct R&D in Europe to be rewarded, and emphasizing that companies entering the European market should also create jobs and value locally. 据《卫报》现场报道，奥博穆列出的压力包括能源成本高、通胀压低消费需求、开发速度需要加快，以及中国车企的竞争。他支持欧盟拟议的「欧洲制造」规则，主张让在欧洲投资和研发的企业得到回报，并强调进入欧洲市场的企业也应在当地创造就业与价值。

Data released by Volkswagen on October 12 also showed pressure in China: 405,800 vehicles were delivered in China in the third quarter, a year-on-year decrease of 38.5%; global deliveries during the same period were 1.8853 million vehicles, a year-on-year decrease of 14.3%. 大众 10 月 12 日公布的数据也显示了在华压力：第三季度在中国交付 40.58 万辆，同比下降 38.5%；同期全球交付 188.53 万辆，同比下降 14.3%。

item.title: 字节海外短剧应用 PineDrama 累计下载破亿
item.guid: 字节海外短剧应用-PineDrama-累计下载破亿
item.description:
According to an original report by Investment Community citing Sensor Tower data, as of September 2026, ByteDance's overseas short-drama app PineDrama has accumulated over 100 million downloads, with approximately 7 million daily active users, becoming one of the fastest-growing products in the overseas short-drama market. 据投资界原创报道援引 Sensor Tower 数据，截至 2026 年 9 月，字节跳动旗下海外短剧应用 PineDrama 累计下载量突破 1 亿，日活跃用户约 700 万，成为海外短剧市场中增长较快的产品之一。

PineDrama primarily targets markets such as Brazil, the United States, and Indonesia, supporting TikTok account login. It adopts a free-to-watch, ad-monetization model: users jump from TikTok short-drama clips to the standalone app, watch ads, and then continue watching the series, similar to the business model of domestic Hongguo short dramas. PineDrama 主要面向巴西、美国和印尼等市场，支持 TikTok 账号登录。它采用免费观看、广告变现的模式：用户从 TikTok 的短剧片段跳转到独立应用，观看广告后继续追剧，与国内红果短剧的商业路径相近。

The report points out that Brazil and Indonesia collectively contributed about 82% of new downloads, and PineDrama has also built a production network, recruited actors, and produced local stories there. Sensor Tower's Q2 market report previously listed it as an app with prominent download growth; this 100 million milestone reflects cumulative installations, not equivalent to daily active users or paying users. 报道指出，巴西和印尼合计贡献了约 82% 的新增下载，PineDrama 也在当地搭建制片网络、招募演员并制作本土故事。Sensor Tower 的第二季度市场报告此前已将其列为下载增长突出的应用；此次破亿数据体现的是累计安装量，不等同于日活或付费用户数。

item.title: Epic 确认转向 AI 加速开发，迪士尼合作游戏或延期
item.guid: Epic-确认转向-AI-加速开发，迪士尼合作游戏或延期
item.description:
Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney stated on X that the company is undergoing a major transformation, reallocating developers and reorganizing workflows to accelerate AI-assisted development. He said the goal is to enable developers to create more and better content and to bring relevant capabilities to teams using Unreal. Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney 在 X 上表示，公司正在进行重大转型，调配开发者、重整工作方式，以加快 AI 辅助开发。他称，目标是让开发者制作更多、更好的内容，并将相关能力带给使用 Unreal 的团队。

Meanwhile, Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier, citing informed sources, reported that a shooting game co-developed by Epic and Disney has been delayed. The project, involving Marvel and Star Wars characters, was originally planned for a March 2027 release, but no new launch date has been announced to the team yet. 与此同时，彭博社记者 Jason Schreier 援引知情人士报道，Epic 与迪士尼合作的一款射击游戏已延期。该项目涉及漫威与《星球大战》角色，原计划于 2027 年 3 月推出，目前尚未向团队公布新的上线日期。

Epic's head of communications, Jake Jones, responded to Bloomberg that the company is adopting "AI-accelerated development," with developers still responsible for creative direction. Sweeney further explained in a reply to the same post that he values shortening the time from idea generation to playtesting; he believes that the inability of game systems to enter playtesting in a timely manner is a reason for the failure of some large games in recent years. Epic 传播负责人 Jake Jones 向彭博社回应，公司正在采用「AI 加速开发」，开发者仍负责创意方向。Sweeney 在同一帖子的回复中进一步解释，他看重的是缩短从产生想法到试玩测试的时间；他认为，游戏系统迟迟无法进入试玩，是近年部分大型游戏失败的原因。

item.title: 曝 DeepSeek 拟领投 Winverse AI，投后估值约 4 亿美元
item.guid: 曝-DeepSeek-拟领投-Winverse-AI，投后估值约-4-亿美元
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, citing informed sources, DeepSeek plans to lead a multi-million dollar seed round for robotics AI startup Winverse AI. This deal is expected to bring Winverse AI's post-money valuation to approximately $400 million, with investors including Meituan's Long-Z Investments also committing to investments. 据彭博社援引知情人士报道，DeepSeek 拟领投机器人 AI 初创公司 Winverse AI 的种子轮融资，规模为数千万美元。这轮交易预计将使 Winverse AI 的投后估值达到约 4 亿美元，美团旗下 Long-Z Investments 等投资方也已作出投资承诺。

Winverse AI was founded by Hu Han in 2026 and is currently in stealth mode. Hu Han previously served as the chief scientist for Tencent's visual language and embodied foundational model team and worked at Microsoft Research Asia and Baidu. The company's AI is developed for robots, not general chat applications. Winverse AI 由胡瀚于 2026 年创立，目前仍处于隐身创业阶段。胡瀚此前担任腾讯视觉语言与具身基础模型团队首席科学家，曾在微软亚洲研究院和百度工作。公司开发的 AI 面向机器人，而非通用聊天应用。

The report states that this could be one of DeepSeek's larger startup investments since its establishment in 2023. The deal has not been finalized, and the valuation and investor list may still change; Hu Han, DeepSeek, and Long-Z did not respond to Bloomberg's request for comment. 报道称，这可能成为 DeepSeek 自 2023 年成立以来规模较大的初创企业投资之一。交易尚未最终敲定，估值及投资方名单仍可能变化；胡瀚、DeepSeek 与 Long-Z 未回应彭博社的置评请求。

item.title: 无问芯穹完成 23 亿元 C 轮融资，累计融资 43 亿元
item.guid: 无问芯穹完成-23-亿元-C-轮融资，累计融资-43-亿元
item.description:
Wuwenshinqiong announced on October 12 the completion of its Series C funding round of 2.3 billion yuan, bringing its total accumulated funding since establishment to 4.3 billion yuan. The company was founded in 2023, originating from technological achievements of Tsinghua University and Shanghai Jiao Tong University, with its business focusing on AI-native infrastructure. 无问芯穹 10 月 12 日宣布完成 23 亿元 C 轮融资，成立以来累计融资额达到 43 亿元。公司成立于 2023 年，由清华大学与上海交通大学的科技成果转化而来，业务聚焦 AI 原生基础设施。

The company divides its existing business into three parts: "front store, back factory, and one center." The computing power distribution center is responsible for organizing various chips and computing resources from different regions, the Token factory provides large model inference services, and the AI productivity store offers industry solutions to enterprises. 公司将现有业务分成「前店、后厂、一中心」三部分：算力集散中心负责组织多种芯片与不同地域的计算资源，Token 工厂提供大模型推理服务，AI 生产力商店则面向企业提供行业解决方案。

According to the company, its infrastructure platform has reached 37,000P of computing power, covers 16 mainstream chips, and supports mixed training with domestic and imported chips. The infrastructure intelligent agents for enterprises include Platform Butler, Intelligent Computing O&M, and the operator generation tool KernelMind, which can select models and computing resources based on task complexity, latency requirements, and Token costs. Currently, the company has partnered with model enterprises such as Zhipu and Moonshot AI, with industry solutions covering entertainment games, healthcare, legal, and energy power. 据公司介绍，其基础设施平台已触达 37,000P 算力、覆盖 16 种主流芯片，并支持国产与进口芯片混合训练。面向企业的基础设施智能体包括平台管家、智算运维和算子生成工具 KernelMind，可按任务复杂度、时延要求及 Token 成本选择模型与算力资源。目前公司已与智谱、月之暗面等模型企业合作，行业方案涉及文娱游戏、医疗、法律和能源电力。

item.title: 💡 王兴兴：过去十几年最大的错误，是对 AI 相信得还不够
item.guid: 💡-王兴兴：过去十几年最大的错误，是对-AI-相信得还不够
item.description:
On October 12, during the in-depth dialogue session at the opening ceremony of the 26th China International Industry Fair, Unitree Robotics founder Wang Xingxing spoke about his judgment on AI: "The biggest mistake I've made in the past decade or so is not believing enough in AI." He stated that his confidence in AI is growing year by year. 10 月 12 日，在第二十六届中国国际工业博览会开幕式的深度对话环节，宇树科技创始人王兴兴谈到自己对 AI 的判断：「过去十几年我犯的最大的错误，就是对 AI 的相信还不太够。」他表示，自己对 AI 的信心正在逐年增强。

According to a live report by the STAR Market Daily, Wang Xingxing believes that global AI technology sees significant updates every one or two months. After the release of GPT-6, the team tested it on different robots for various tasks, and the actual results were good, which also changed the perception of technological progress among practitioners in the embodied AI industry. 据《科创板日报》现场报道，王兴兴认为，全球 AI 技术每隔一两个月就有很大的更新。GPT-6 发布后，团队将其放到不同机器人上进行任务测试，实际效果不错，这也改变了具身智能行业从业者对技术进展的认知。

Based on this, he judges that the tipping point for embodied AI might come relatively quickly, possibly even within one or two years if fast. However, before large-scale application in factories, robots still need to improve their generalization capabilities and efficiency; Unitree and other robotics companies are currently conducting pilot programs in factories, and he believes these issues may be resolved in the next few years. 他据此判断，具身智能的临界点可能来得较快，快的话甚至一两年内就有可能。但在工厂大规模应用之前，机器人仍需要提高泛化能力和效率；宇树及其他机器人企业目前已在工厂开展试点，他判断，这些问题未来几年可能得到解决。

Regarding the deployment order, Wang Xingxing's judgment is that commercial services might advance faster than industrial applications, while home scenarios would be relatively later. 对于落地顺序，王兴兴的判断是，商业服务可能比工业领域推进得更快，居家场景则相对靠后。

item.title: 5699 元起，一加 16 发布：185Hz 屏幕、9000mAh 电池
item.guid: 5699-元起，一加-16-发布：185Hz-屏幕、9000mAh-电池
item.description:
OnePlus released the OnePlus 16 on October 12, focusing on high frame rate mobile gaming experience, equipped with the sixth-generation Snapdragon 8 Super Extreme Edition and a new generation "Wind-Speed Game Kernel", and adopting self-developed "Esports Triple-Core" technology. 一加 10 月 12 日发布一加 16，主打高帧率手游体验，搭载第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版和全新一代「风驰游戏内核」，并采用自研「电竞三芯」。

    Screen: 6.78-inch flat screen with a resolution of 2772 × 1272; supports 1–165Hz intelligent switching in non-gaming scenarios, and up to 185Hz in gaming scenarios.

    Camera: Rear setup includes a 200-megapixel wide-angle, 50-megapixel ultra-wide-angle, and 50-megapixel telephoto lens. Both wide-angle and telephoto support OIS, with up to 3x optical zoom. The front camera is a 50-megapixel autofocus camera.

    Battery Life: Equivalent to a 9000mAh dual-cell battery, supporting up to 100W wired and 50W wireless charging.

    Body and System: Available in three colors: Starlight of Tomorrow, Martian Masterpiece, and Dark Forest. Weighs approximately 217–220g, supports IP66, IP68, IP69, and IP69K dust and water resistance, runs ColorOS 17, and features an under-display ultrasonic fingerprint sensor.

The official store shows that the pre-sale prices for the 12GB + 256GB, 12GB + 512GB, 16GB + 512GB, and 16GB + 1TB versions are 5699 yuan, 6499 yuan, 7199 yuan, and 8199 yuan, respectively. The first three versions are expected to ship starting October 13, and the 1TB version is expected to ship starting October 18. 官方商城显示，12GB + 256GB、12GB + 512GB、16GB + 512GB 和 16GB + 1TB 版本预售价分别为 5699 元、6499 元、7199 元和 8199 元。前三个版本预计 10 月 13 日起陆续发货，1TB 版本预计 10 月 18 日起发货。

🔗 Related Reading: OnePlus 16 Experience: Toning Down the Edge, Still a "No-Mistake" Flagship 🔗 相关阅读： 一加 16 体验：收敛锐气，依然是「不出错」的旗舰

item.title: CMF 推出「牛奶盒」音箱，面板与旋钮支持 3D 打印替换
item.guid: CMF-推出「牛奶盒」音箱，面板与旋钮支持-3D-打印替换
item.description:
CMF by Nothing launched its first portable speaker series, Speaker S and Speaker M. Both feature a "milk carton" geometric design, with interchangeable front panels and knobs. The brand provides official 3D design files for users to print personalized parts. Nothing 旗下 CMF 发布首款便携音箱系列 Speaker S 与 Speaker M。两款采用「牛奶盒」式几何造型，前面板和旋钮可拆换，品牌提供官方 3D 设计文件，供用户打印个性化部件。

    Speaker S: Features a 45mm full-range driver and two passive radiators, with an output power of 10W RMS. The top can be fitted with a shoulder strap or carabiner. The price in Japan, including tax, is 9800 yen.

    Speaker M: Features a 70mm woofer and a 16mm tweeter, with a total output power of 35W RMS. The body has an integrated handle. The price in Japan, including tax, is 17800 yen.

Both models support Bluetooth 6.0, USB-C audio, dual device connection, and synchronization of multiple compatible speakers via Auracast; two units of the same model can form a stereo pair. The body has IP68 dust and water resistance and is available in white, dark gray, orange, and teal. 两款均支持蓝牙 6.0、USB-C 音频、双设备连接，以及通过 Auracast 同步多台兼容音箱；同型号两台可组成立体声。机身具备 IP68 防尘防水，提供白、深灰、橙和青绿四种颜色。

Under 50% volume and with Ultra Bass enabled, the official stated battery life is up to 18 hours, and 10 minutes of charging provides approximately 1 hour of playback. It went on sale in the Japanese market on October 12. 在 50% 音量、开启 Ultra Bass 的条件下，官方标称续航最长为 18 小时，充电 10 分钟可播放约 1 小时。日本市场于 10 月 12 日开售。

item.title: Meta 发布 Muse Wonder 系列模型，面向长时间 Agent 任务
item.guid: Meta-发布-Muse-Wonder-系列模型，面向长时间-Agent-任务
item.description:
Meta released two models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, on October 12, targeting agent tasks in programming, personal, and professional domains. Muse Wonder is now open to developers via Meta Model API and Muse Code, while the Full version is available to Muse Code subscribers. Meta 于 10 月 12 日发布 Muse Wonder 与 Muse Wonder Full 两款模型，面向编程及个人、专业领域的智能体任务。Muse Wonder 已通过 Meta Model API 和 Muse Code 向开发者开放，Full 版本则供 Muse Code 订阅用户使用。

Both models incorporate Active Memory and Active Focus. The former retains important context across conversations and retrieves relevant information in subsequent tasks; the latter is used to continuously execute complex goals, attempting alternative methods, handling errors when encountering obstacles, and, when necessary, asking clarifying questions and confirming with the user before performing critical actions. 两款模型加入 Active Memory 和 Active Focus。前者跨对话保留重要上下文，并在后续任务中检索相关信息；后者用于持续执行复杂目标，在遇到障碍时尝试其他方法、处理错误，并在必要时提出澄清问题、执行重要操作前向用户确认。

Tasks demonstrated by Meta include understanding leases, processing insurance claims, and generating playable 3D games. The company states that the models are trained in its gigawatt-scale Prometheus data centers, with training tasks including long-term software projects; tests such as FocusBench and SWE-Marathon were used to evaluate continuous execution capabilities. Meta 展示的任务包括理解租约、处理保险理赔和生成可玩的 3D 游戏。公司称，模型在其吉瓦级 Prometheus 数据中心训练，训练任务包含需要长时间推进的软件项目；评估持续执行能力时使用了 FocusBench 和 SWE-Marathon 等测试。

Muse Wonder will subsequently be integrated into Muse, initially rolling out to subscribers and used for generating applications and other content. The aforementioned capabilities and evaluation performance are based on Meta's self-published introduction. Muse Wonder 后续还将接入 Muse，率先向订阅用户推出，并用于生成应用等内容。上述能力与评测表现来自 Meta 自行发布的介绍。

🔗 Related Reading: Just now, Zuckerberg released a mysterious "Watermelon" model, with benchmarks comparable to Opus 5.5, but its reputation is hard to describe 🔗 相关阅读： 刚刚，小扎发布神秘「西瓜」模型，跑分媲美 Opus 5.5，口碑却一言难尽

item.title: 安克与飞书推出 AI 会议耳机，录音可直接生成纪要
item.guid: 安克与飞书推出-AI-会议耳机，录音可直接生成纪要
item.description:
Anker and Feishu jointly launched AI conference headphones, integrating recordings of phone calls, online meetings, and in-person discussions into Feishu, supporting real-time transcription, summarization, and meeting minute generation. The product is scheduled for full platform spot sale on October 12 at 20:00. 安克与飞书联合推出 AI 会议耳机，将电话、线上会议和当面交流的录音接入飞书，支持实时转写、总结与会议纪要生成，产品定于 10 月 12 日 20:00 全平台现货发售。

Usage varies by scenario: After connecting to a phone call or online meeting, double-tap the headphones to start recording, supporting conference software like Feishu, DingTalk, Tencent Meeting, Teams, etc. For in-person discussions, the charging case's built-in microphone can be used for recording, eliminating the need to wear the headphones. 使用方式按场景区分：接入电话或线上会议后，双击耳机即可开始录音，支持飞书、钉钉、腾讯会议、Teams 等会议软件；线下面对面交流时，可使用充电盒内置麦克风录音，无需佩戴耳机。

Recording files are automatically saved to Feishu. Feishu AI can distinguish speakers, translate 24 languages, and extract key points and conclusions during the recording process. The generated multimodal minutes include charts, to-dos, and key sentences, and also support asking questions about the recording content. 录音文件会自动存入飞书。飞书 AI 可区分发言人、进行 24 种语言的翻译，并在录音过程中提炼重点与结论；生成的多模态纪要包含图表、待办及关键语句，也支持围绕录音内容提问。

These headphones can be set up directly in Feishu without needing to install another app. The charging case features a 1.78-inch touchscreen, allowing some operations to be performed independently of a phone. The official statement claims that recording data is stored with AES-256 encryption. 这副耳机可以直接在飞书中完成设置，无需另装 App。充电盒配有 1.78 英寸触控屏，可脱离手机进行部分操作。官方称，录音数据采用 AES-256 加密存储。

item.title: 华为折叠机累计发货突破 2000 万台，披露定位与相机技术
item.guid: 华为折叠机累计发货突破-2000-万台，披露定位与相机技术
item.description:
On October 12, Huawei held a terminal innovation technology communication conference at Lianqiuhu, Shanghai. According to reports from "Sci-Tech Innovation Board Daily", Huawei's cumulative shipments of foldable phones have exceeded 20 million units. Li Xiaolong, CTO of Terminal BG, also introduced the implementation details of the Star Trace Positioning technology and the Ruiying Z10 modular camera. 10 月 12 日，华为在上海练秋湖举行终端创新技术沟通会。据《科创板日报》获悉，华为折叠机累计发货量已突破 2000 万台。终端 BG CTO 李小龙还介绍了星迹定位技术及睿影 Z10 模块相机的实现细节。

    Star Trace Positioning: Achieves sub-meter level positioning for lane navigation through HiSilicon short-range chips and GNSS carrier phase measurement; within tunnels, it combines AI speed estimation with geomagnetic matching. The Mate 90 series' Precise Car Finding 2.0 uses 3D road network matching to record parking locations, with floor accuracy exceeding 95% and position accuracy less than 10 meters, currently covering over 30,000 underground garages. Petal Maps' mall store-level navigation now supports over 260 malls.

    Ruiying Z10: This modular camera, released on October 1st, integrates multiple sensors such as Hongfeng, and can collaborate with a phone's SoC to achieve fusion focusing. Its independent optical image stabilization module can also work with Kirin chips. It features a HyperClick super mount, allowing the use of 77mm filters with a SmallRig adapter ring; Li Xiaolong also stated that the independent mount adapter design can adapt to more future models.

Sports scenarios were also covered in this introduction: the Mate 90 series supports stadium track-level navigation, the WATCH GT Runner 2 improves GNSS signals through a 3D floating antenna, and wrist-worn ski resort maps now cover over 3,000 ski resorts. 运动场景也在此次介绍范围内：Mate 90 系列支持运动场跑道级导航，WATCH GT Runner 2 通过 3D 悬浮天线改善 GNSS 信号，腕上雪场地图已覆盖 3000 多个雪场。

item.title: Step 5 Preview 上线 WorkBuddy，限免至 10 月 25 日
item.guid: Step-5-Preview-上线-WorkBuddy，限免至-10-月-25-日
item.description:
Jiyue Xingchen announced that Step 5 Preview is now available on Tencent WorkBuddy, with an exclusive free trial running from October 12th to 25th on WorkBuddy. 阶跃星辰宣布，Step 5 Preview 已上线腾讯 WorkBuddy，10 月 12 日至 25 日在 WorkBuddy 开启独家限免。

This model was launched on September 20th, targeting tasks such as AI programming, software engineering, professional knowledge work, and finance. It adopts a sparse MoE architecture with a total of 600B parameters, activating 27B parameters per inference, supporting a 1 million Token context, as well as text and visual input. 这款模型于 9 月 20 日推出，面向 AI 编程、软件工程、专业知识工作和金融等任务。它采用稀疏 MoE 架构，总参数量为 600B、每次激活 27B 参数，支持 100 万 Token 上下文，以及文本和视觉输入。

This update is the free trial arrangement for the model in WorkBuddy. Jiyue previously announced that the subsequent plan is to open-source the full weights on October 15th. 本次更新是模型在 WorkBuddy 中的限免安排。阶跃此前公布的后续计划是于 10 月 15 日开源完整权重。

item.title: 微软发布 Maia 300，计划明年扩大至数吉瓦部署
item.guid: 微软发布-Maia-300，计划明年扩大至数吉瓦部署
item.description:
Microsoft unveiled its third-generation self-developed AI inference system, Maia 300, with production deployment planned to begin in 2027. The Azure Maia series will be expanded to a multi-gigawatt scale, serving as the primary inference system for Microsoft products and services. 微软公布第三代自研 AI 推理系统 Maia 300，计划于 2027 年开始生产部署，并将 Azure Maia 系列扩展至数吉瓦规模，作为微软产品与服务的主要推理系统。

Maia 300 is designed for long-context inference, low-latency conversations, and multi-step agent tasks. Microsoft expects it to process 40% more tokens per megawatt compared to mainstream GPU systems; in a full 96-accelerator configuration, rack-level token throughput is up to 7 times that of Maia 200. Maia 300 针对长上下文推理、低延迟对话及多步骤 Agent 任务设计。微软预计，相比主流 GPU 系统，其每兆瓦可处理的 token 数增加 40%；在完整的 96 加速器配置下，机架级 token 吞吐量最高为 Maia 200 的 7 倍。

The hardware adopts a multi-chiplet architecture, with computing chiplets using TSMC's N2P process. Each accelerator is equipped with 8 stacks of HBM4, offering a peak memory bandwidth of 18TB/s and a TDP of 950W; a full rack accommodates 96 accelerators within a 167kW power consumption range, with a total HBM capacity of 27.6TB. 硬件采用多芯粒架构，计算芯粒使用台积电 N2P 工艺。每颗加速器配备 8 组 HBM4，峰值内存带宽为 18TB/s，TDP 为 950W；整机架在 167kW 功耗范围内容纳 96 颗加速器，总 HBM 容量为 27.6TB。

The previous generation Maia 200 is already serving production workloads like Copilot and has been deployed in the US, Europe, and Australia. GitHub Copilot and Microsoft Foundry are planned to be integrated by the end of the year. 上一代 Maia 200 已服务于 Copilot 等生产负载，并在美国、欧洲和澳大利亚部署。GitHub Copilot 与 Microsoft Foundry 计划于年底前接入。

item.title: AMD 发布 Helion 智能体机架，纯 CPU 方案最高 32768 核
item.guid: AMD-发布-Helion-智能体机架，纯-CPU-方案最高-32768-核
item.description:
AMD released the Helion rack reference design for agent workloads, based on Open Compute Project (OCP) specifications, supporting adjustments to CPU, GPU, power consumption, and cooling configurations as required by tasks. AMD 发布面向 Agent 工作负载的 Helion 机架参考设计，以开放计算项目 OCP 规范为基础，支持按任务需要调整 CPU、GPU、功耗及散热配置。

Helion offers two types of solutions: Helion 提供两类方案：

    Pure CPU Rack: Utilizes sixth-generation EPYC processors, supporting up to 32,768 CPU cores for large-scale agent execution, and connects to independent model inference infrastructure.

    Integrated Rack: Consolidates EPYC CPU nodes, Instinct MI350P GPU nodes, and general-purpose computing onto a single platform, designed for enterprise deployment.

The system integrates a token router to allocate calls between cutting-edge and open-source models based on tasks, and supports both air and liquid cooling designs. AMD plans to contribute the Helion specification to OCP and is developing rack configurations with ecosystem partners, with an expected launch in November 2026. 系统集成 token 路由器，按任务在前沿模型与开源模型之间分配调用，并支持风冷及液冷设计。AMD 计划向 OCP 贡献 Helion 规范，正与生态伙伴开发机架配置，预计于 2026 年 11 月推出。

item.title: Decision 3.0 开源：直接做判断，支持图片与视频输入
item.guid: Decision-3.0-开源：直接做判断，支持图片与视频输入
item.description:
The vLLM Semantic Router team has launched the Decision 3.0 series of open-source decision models, including six models: d3, d3-flash, d3-mini, d3-nano, d3-lite, and d3-edge, covering parameter scales from approximately 0.6B to 27B. Their weights have been released on Hugging Face. vLLM Semantic Router 团队推出 Decision 3.0 系列开源决策模型，包含 d3、d3-flash、d3-mini、d3-nano、d3-lite 和 d3-edge 六款，覆盖约 0.6B 至 27B 参数规模，权重已在 Hugging Face 发布。

The model accepts text or JSON, and can also combine multiple images and videos to answer preset options, true/false questions, or rating tasks, returning the probability for each answer. A single request can handle multiple questions around the same input without needing to generate lengthy responses. 模型接收文本或 JSON，也能结合多张图片和视频，对预设选项、是非问题或评分任务作答，返回每个答案的概率。一次请求可以处理围绕同一份输入的多个问题，无须生成长篇回答。

The flagship d3 is based on Qwen3.8-27B and uses the Apache 2.0 license. In the Jev Decision Index 0.3.1 evaluation released by the team, d3's text decision index was 64.7, and its visual index was 71.6; the leaderboard data and internal video tests used different metrics. 旗舰 d3 基于 Qwen3.8-27B，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。在团队公布的 Jev Decision Index 0.3.1 测评中，d3 文本决策指数为 64.7、视觉指数为 71.6；榜单数据与内部视频测试使用不同口径。

The team measured median text request latency at 55 milliseconds, image requests at 273 milliseconds, and 10-second video requests at 553 milliseconds, all on a single AMD Instinct MI325X, processing one request at a time. The model can be deployed locally, and native support for vLLM Semantic Router is currently in the development pipeline. 团队在单张 AMD Instinct MI325X、一次处理一个请求的条件下，测得文本请求延迟中位数为 55 毫秒，图片请求为 273 毫秒，10 秒视频请求为 553 毫秒。模型可本地部署，vLLM Semantic Router 的原生支持目前位于开发通道。

item.title: 纳微与英伟达推出 24kW 供电板，单级转换 800V 至 12V
item.guid: 纳微与英伟达推出-24kW-供电板，单级转换-800V-至-12V
item.description:
Navitas Semiconductor announced a collaboration with NVIDIA to develop a 24kW DC power board that can directly convert 800V DC to 12V, targeting the NVIDIA MGX ecosystem and AI data centers. The solution is planned for demonstration in the NVIDIA partner exhibition area at OCP Global Summit 2026. 纳微半导体宣布，与英伟达合作开发一款 24kW 直流供电板，可将 800V 直流电直接转换为 12V，面向英伟达 MGX 生态及 AI 数据中心。该方案计划在 OCP Global Summit 2026 的英伟达合作伙伴展区展示。

The new power board uses GaNFast gallium nitride devices, eliminating the original 50V to 12V intermediate bus conversion step through single-stage conversion, and then delivering 12V power to the voltage regulator modules that supply the processor. 新供电板采用 GaNFast 氮化镓器件，通过单级转换省去原有 50V 至 12V 的中间母线转换环节，再将 12V 电力送至为处理器供电的电压调节模块。

Navitas states a full-load target efficiency of 97% and a power density exceeding 2000W per cubic inch. The power board adopts a 400mm × 60mm form factor, allowing integration onto the computing motherboard and deployment close to the processor, reducing power path losses. This is a new version following their previous 20kW, 800V to 6V solution. 纳微给出的满载目标效率为 97%，功率密度超过每立方英寸 2000W。供电板采用 400mm × 60mm 形态，可集成在计算主板上、靠近处理器部署，减少供电路径损耗。这是双方此前 20kW、800V 至 6V 方案之后的新版本。

item.title: 《无人深空》10 月 28 日登陆 iOS，支持 iPhone 11 起的设备
item.guid: 《无人深空》10-月-28-日登陆-iOS，支持-iPhone-11-起的设备
item.description:
Hello Games announced that the iOS version of "No Man's Sky" will launch on October 28th, with pre-orders now open on the App Store, offering a free trial at launch. The game supports iPhone 11, third-generation iPad Air, and newer devices, with an installation size of less than 4GB. Hello Games 宣布，《无人深空》iOS 版将于 10 月 28 日推出，现已在 App Store 开放预订，首发时可免费试玩。游戏支持 iPhone 11、第三代 iPad Air 及更新设备，安装体积不到 4GB。

The mobile version includes content from over 40 major updates, including the recent Cosmos and last year's Voyagers, which added large buildable starships. The universe is still generated in real-time by the device, allowing players to explore planets, pilot ships, and build bases; the development team has redesigned ground movement, flight, crafting, and inventory operations for touchscreens, and also supports controllers, TV casting, and mouse and keyboard on iPad. 移动版包含超过 40 次主要更新的内容，包括近期的 Cosmos 和去年加入大型自建飞船的 Voyagers。宇宙仍由设备实时生成，玩家可以探索星球、驾驶飞船、建造基地；开发团队为触屏重新设计了地面移动、飞行、制作与背包操作，也支持手柄、电视投屏，以及 iPad 上的鼠标和键盘。

The mobile version also has feature limitations: multiplayer mode is not supported, and planetary settlements are only available on iPhone 15 Pro and newer models. Hello Games stated that they will continue to support this version based on player feedback and actual player numbers. 移动版也有功能限制：多人模式不支持，星球定居点仅在 iPhone 15 Pro 及更新机型上提供。Hello Games 表示，将依据玩家反馈及实际游玩人数继续支持这一版本。

Co-founder Sean Murray also told the media that the team borrowed performance and memory optimizations from the development of their new game, "Light No Fire"; both games share the same engine, and some optimizations will also benefit other platforms. 联合创始人 Sean Murray 还向媒体介绍，团队从新作《Light No Fire》的开发中借用了性能和内存优化；两款游戏共享同一引擎，部分优化也会惠及其他平台。

item.title: 千问介绍 QwenGyre：让数小时的 Agent 任务参与强化学习
item.guid: 千问介绍-QwenGyre：让数小时的-Agent-任务参与强化学习
item.description:
On October 12, the Qwen team introduced QwenGyre, an online reinforcement learning framework for ultra-long-range agent tasks, hoping to make tasks lasting several hours, such as generating code repositories, reproducing systems, and refactoring code, serve as training material for model learning. The related paper was submitted to arXiv on September 27. 千问团队 10 月 12 日介绍了面向超长程智能体任务的在线强化学习框架 QwenGyre，希望让生成代码仓库、复现系统和重构代码等持续数小时的任务，成为模型学习的训练材料。相关论文已于 9 月 27 日提交至 arXiv。

Such tasks may involve hundreds of rounds of interdependent model-environment interactions, with highly variable task completion times, leading to idle GPUs while waiting for all tasks to finish; historical compression, sub-agents, and retries generate branched trajectories, which can lead to redundant computations. 这类任务可能包含数百轮相互依赖的模型与环境交互，任务结束时间差异很大，等待全部任务完成会让 GPU 闲置；历史压缩、子智能体和重试产生的分叉轨迹，又会带来重复计算。

QwenGyre divides GPUs into switchable computing units. Without interrupting ongoing tasks and while preserving workspace and tool states, idle computing power is gradually shifted to training. Trajectory processing retains the true context when each output segment is generated, scores verifiable partial results, and removes redundant paths. QwenGyre 将 GPU 划分为可切换用途的计算单元。在不打断正在执行的任务、保留工作区与工具状态的情况下，逐步将空闲算力转入训练。轨迹处理则保留每段输出生成时的真实上下文，对可检验的部分成果评分，并去除重复路径。

The team conducted experiments on Qwen3.8-2.4T, processing approximately 700,000 tokens cumulatively per execution. After 48 training steps, the NL2RepoBench pass rate increased from 52.48% to 58.54%; under the same GPU budget, training time decreased from 134.55 hours for the Async solution to 75.42 hours, a reduction of approximately 44%. Cumulative tokens include input, output, and repeatedly read historical context from each round, not the length of a single context window. 团队在 Qwen3.8-2.4T 上进行实验，每次执行累计处理约 70 万 token。经过 48 步训练，NL2RepoBench 通过率从 52.48% 升至 58.54%；在相同 GPU 预算下，训练耗时从 Async 方案的 134.55 小时降至 75.42 小时，缩短约 44%。累计 token 包括各轮输入、输出和重复读取的历史上下文，并非单次上下文窗口长度。

item.title: 星巴克公布软酪咖啡系列，拿铁加上马斯卡彭软酪顶
item.guid: 星巴克公布软酪咖啡系列，拿铁加上马斯卡彭软酪顶
item.description:
Starbucks China announced that its Cream Cheese Coffee series will launch on October 13, including three beverages: Cream Cheese Latte, Cream Cheese Americano, and Pistachio Cream Cheese Latte. 星巴克中国宣布，软酪咖啡系列将于 10 月 13 日上新，包括软酪拿铁、软酪美式和开心果软酪拿铁三款饮品。

The series features a roughly 2cm thick cream cheese topping paired with classic Italian espresso. Official materials for the Cream Cheese Latte indicate that the top layer uses mascarpone cream cheese; actual thickness may vary slightly due to manual preparation. 系列以约 2cm 厚的软酪顶搭配经典意式浓缩咖啡。软酪拿铁的官方物料标示，顶层使用马斯卡彭软酪；实际厚度会因手工调制略有差异。

According to the introduction, the series offers hot and cold drinks as well as decaf options. The three drinks are paired with latte, Americano, and pistachio flavors, respectively. The Cream Cheese Latte and Cream Cheese Americano have light-colored toppings, while the Pistachio Cream Cheese Latte features a green top layer. 据介绍，该系列提供冷热饮及低因选择。三款分别搭配拿铁、美式与开心果风味，软酪拿铁和软酪美式的顶部为浅色，开心果软酪拿铁则呈现绿色顶层。

item.title: 小岛工作室联名 CASETiFY，推出《死亡搁浅》手机配件
item.guid: 小岛工作室联名-CASETiFY，推出《死亡搁浅》手机配件
item.description:
CASETiFY announced a collaboration with Kojima Productions for a joint collection, commemorating CASETiFY's 15th anniversary and the studio's 10th anniversary, launching globally on October 15th. Hideo Kojima and Art Director Yoji Shinkawa participated in the design at the Tokyo studio, incorporating visual elements from the "Death Stranding" series and the studio into phone cases and accessories. CASETiFY 宣布与小岛工作室推出联名系列，纪念 CASETiFY 成立 15 周年与工作室成立 10 周年，10 月 15 日全球开售。小岛秀夫与美术总监新川洋司在东京工作室参与设计，把《死亡搁浅》系列与工作室的视觉元素用于手机壳和配件。

The series features Yoji Shinkawa's designed 3D aluminum phone cases, also including art models with gold lens rings, Ludens logo carbon fiber models, and phone cases featuring "Death Stranding 2" patterns, studio logos, and damage sensor tape elements. Some styles present the texture of in-game items through 3D modeling and material details. 系列主打新川洋司设计的立体铝制手机壳，也包括带金色镜头环的艺术款、Ludens 标志碳纤维款，以及采用《死亡搁浅 2》图案、工作室标志和损坏感应胶带元素的手机壳。部分款式通过立体造型和材质细节呈现游戏道具的质感。

Accessories include Qpid wrist straps, Dollman and Duck Ludens plush keychains, metal grip stands, and more. Phone cases cover some Apple, Samsung, and Google models; the official Japanese announcement states phone cases start from 6380 JPY including tax, tech accessories from 5610 JPY, and luggage from 79530 JPY. Purchasing series products will also come with a random collectible card, with two additional limited card designs for the 3D aluminum cases. 配件包括 Qpid 腕绳、Dollman 与 Duck Ludens 毛绒钥匙扣、金属握持支架等。手机壳覆盖部分苹果、三星和 Google 机型；日本官方公布，手机壳含税 6380 日元起，科技配件 5610 日元起，行李箱 79530 日元起。购买系列产品还将附随机收藏卡，立体铝壳另有两种限定卡面。

item.title: 霸王茶姬买一送一爆单，拟发 1350 万元奖励门店员工
item.guid: 霸王茶姬买一送一爆单，拟发-1350-万元奖励门店员工
item.description:
On October 12, CHAGEE launched an all-day "buy one get one free" event to celebrate its global brand ambassador Zheng Qinwen's championship win, but the ordering mini-program subsequently experienced a malfunction. The brand apologized to consumers, stating that the mini-program was temporarily unable to handle the enthusiasm of tea lovers and was being repaired. 10 月 12 日，霸王茶姬为庆祝全球品牌代言人郑钦文夺冠，推出全天「买一送一」活动，下单小程序随后出现故障。品牌向消费者致歉，表示小程序一时难以承受茶友的热情，正在修复。

A Beijing News reporter saw the message "Tea lovers are too enthusiastic, please try again later" in the mini-program, requiring repeated refreshes to enter the ordering page. Stores like Beijing Huiju, Xidan Updates, and Wukesong Huaxi once showed as busy or unable to take orders, with some stores having over 200 cups in queue. A Shanghai consumer stated that there were over 100 cups ahead of them when ordering, and they received their drink about an hour and a half later. 新京报记者在小程序中看到「茶友们太热情了，请稍后再试」提示，需要反复刷新才能进入点单页面。北京荟聚、西单更新场、五棵松华熙等门店一度显示繁忙或无法点单，部分门店排队杯量超过 200 杯。一名上海消费者称，下单时前面已有 100 多杯，约一个半小时后才收到饮品。

The event is limited to October 12th, from 00:00 to 23:59. When purchasing two or more drinks via the mini-program, the lower-priced drink will be discounted. Each ID is limited to one use. On the evening of October 11th, Zheng Qinwen defeated Andreeva 2-0 in the China Open women's singles final, securing her first WTA 1000-level title. 该活动限定于 10 月 12 日 00:00 至 23:59，在小程序购买任意两杯及以上饮品时减免价格较低的一杯，每个 ID 限一次。10 月 11 日晚，郑钦文在中网女单决赛中以 2 比 0 击败安德列娃，拿下个人首个 WTA 1000 级别冠军。

According to reports from Yicai and China Newsweek, BaWangChaJi sent an internal thank-you letter to all its stores that night, planning to distribute a total of 13.5 million yuan in special bonuses: 3.5 million yuan for "partner team-building fees" and another 10 million yuan for "partner incentive special red packets." The letter stated that the event's order volume far exceeded expectations, and specific distribution details would be announced later by the operations center. 据第一财经及中新经纬报道，霸王茶姬当晚向全国门店发出内部感谢信，计划发放总计 1350 万元专项奖励：350 万元用于「伙伴团建费」，另有 1000 万元为「伙伴激励专项红包」。感谢信称，活动订单量远超预期，具体发放细则将由营运中心后续通知。

item.title: 《复仇者联盟 5》中国内地定档 12 月 16 日
item.guid: 《复仇者联盟-5》中国内地定档-12-月-16-日
item.description:
Disney China announced that "Avengers 5" will be released in mainland China on December 16th, and has unveiled its Chinese release poster. 迪士尼中国宣布，《复仇者联盟 5》将于 12 月 16 日在中国内地上映，并发布中文定档海报。

The film sees the return of Anthony and Joe Russo as directors, with Kevin Feige serving as producer. The story will push heroes from three different universes into a collision; Feige stated that the film will pick up after the ending of "Avengers 4: Endgame," bringing together Marvel characters from various universes. 影片由安东尼·罗素与乔·罗素回归执导，凯文·费奇担任制片人。故事将三个不同宇宙的英雄推向一场碰撞；费奇表示，影片会接续《复仇者联盟 4：终局之战》的结尾，让来自不同宇宙的漫威角色汇合。

Chris Evans as Steve Rogers and Chris Hemsworth as Thor will return. The X-Men will also join, led by Patrick Stewart as Professor X and Ian McKellen as Magneto. The Fantastic Four and Thunderbolts are also featured in this officially announced lineup. 克里斯·埃文斯饰演的史蒂夫·罗杰斯与克里斯·海姆斯沃斯饰演的雷神索尔将回归。X 战警也将加入，由帕特里克·斯图尔特饰演的 X 教授、伊恩·麦克莱恩饰演的万磁王领衔，神奇四侠与雷霆特攻队同样出现在本次官宣阵容中。

The release poster lists screening formats including 2D, 3D, CINITY, CINITY LED, IMAX, China Giant Screen, and Dolby Cinema. 定档海报列出的放映格式包括 2D、3D、CINITY、CINITY LED、IMAX、中国巨幕及杜比影院。

item.title: 徐克在卢米埃尔电影节透露伦敦喜剧计划，悼念施南生
item.guid: 徐克在卢米埃尔电影节透露伦敦喜剧计划，悼念施南生
item.description:
According to Variety's on-site report, Tsui Hark revealed at a masterclass at the Lumière Film Festival in Lyon, France, on October 11th, that he is preparing a comedy set in London, hoping to bring characters from different cultures together to face serious issues and find humor through collaboration. 据 Variety 现场报道，徐克 10 月 11 日在法国里昂卢米埃尔电影节大师班上，透露正在筹备一部以伦敦为背景的喜剧，希望让不同文化的人物一起面对严肃问题，从合作中找到幽默。

At the beginning of the masterclass, after watching a montage of his career works, Tsui Hark mourned his long-time producing partner Nansun Shi, who passed away in July. The two founded Film Workshop in 1984, continued to collaborate after their divorce, and jointly received the Hong Kong Film Awards Lifetime Achievement Award in 2025. 大师班开始时，徐克看过职业生涯作品剪辑后，悼念 7 月去世的长期制片伙伴施南生。两人于 1984 年创办电影工作室，离婚后仍持续合作，并在 2025 年共同获得香港电影金像奖终身成就奖。

Speaking about AI, Tsui Hark said that it's becoming increasingly difficult for people to judge whether what they see is real or fake, and this uncertainty also frightens him. He still believes that film can incorporate humor into serious subjects like war, viruses, and economic problems, helping people see the world from another perspective. 谈到 AI，徐克说，人们越来越难判断眼前的东西是真是假，这种不确定性也让他感到害怕。他仍相信，电影可以在战争、病毒和经济问题等严肃题材中加入幽默，帮助人们从另一个角度看世界。

The film festival will screen four of Tsui Hark's works: "Shanghai Blues," "Peking Opera Blues," "Once Upon a Time in China," and "Time and Tide." The event runs until October 18th. 电影节将放映《上海之夜》《刀马旦》《黄飞鸿》和《顺流逆流》四部徐克作品，活动持续至 10 月 18 日。
